summary_notes: Sales discovery with Marguerite at Tidewell Home Care. Current scheduling vendor is being replaced after a staff-data breach; contract ends January 15, so go-live is needed before then, avoiding summer. Pain points: handoffs, staff location, spreadsheets/group texts, rural connectivity, adoption. Needs calendar sync, accounting integration, mobile/tablet app, offline sync, visit notes. Initial seat count 60 corrected to 85 including per-diem contractors. Team $14, Enterprise $26 per seat annually; REP authorized up to 15% discount. Theodora (compliance) has final say. Next: proposal for 85 seats by Friday; security review Tuesday, October 6, 10 a.m.; security docs ahead. REP incorrectly promised BAA on Team and disclosed another client's pricing.
notable_details: Company: Tidewell Home Care; prospect: Marguerite, director of operations.
Current vendor contract ends January 15; go-live needed before then; avoid summer rollout.
Current vendor had a data breach last spring exposing staff data, not clinical data.
Seat count corrected from 60 to 85 after adding about 25 per-diem nurses/therapists.
Pricing: Team $14/seat/month, Enterprise $26/seat/month, billed annually; REP authorized up to 15% discount.
BAA availability: REP initially said BAA only on Enterprise, later incorrectly promised BAA on Team.

Security review scheduled for Tuesday, October 6, 10 a.m. with Theodora; SOC 2 and questionnaire to be sent ahead.
Proposal for 85 seats promised by Friday.
